{{Quote|Naga Sadow considers the death of a star system a small price for his own survival.|[[Vodo-Siosk Baas]]'s [[Tedryn Holocron|holocron]], to [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]|<ref name="DLotS1" />}}
The '''Denarii system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained a [[Binary star system/Legends|pair]] of [[Star/Legends|stars]] known as the [[Denarii Nova]].<ref name="DLotS1" />

==History==
{{Quote|Steer our vessel between the Denarii suns&mdash;it is time to remind the Republic of the power of the dark side!|Naga Sadow|<ref name="DLotS1" />}}
[[File:Denarii_system_TEA.jpg|thumb|left|225px|The Denarii system and its surrounding systems]]
At the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] flew his damaged [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']], between the [[Binary star system/Legends|binary stars]] of the [[Denarii Nova]] to escape the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Koros fleet|forces]] that pursued him.<ref name="TFotSE5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref> The [[Sith sorcerer]] [[Battle at the Denarii Nova|used]] his [[Sith sorcery/Legends|powers]] to [[Supernova (Sith magic)|manipulate]] the [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]] of the Denarii Nova, thus creating an explosion that destroyed the Republic [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in his wake.<ref name="TFotSE5" />

This cataclysmic event resulted in the destruction of the entire [[Star system/Legends|system]],<ref name="DLotS1" /> which created a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] of highly ionized [[Gas/Legends|gases]] known as the [[Denarii Nebula/Legends|Denarii Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />
